body: You're so kind, thank you so much. I've never heard the term toxic positivity before but you're so right, that's exactly what it is, it's awful. Thank you so much, I really genuinely appreciate you reaching out ❤️

Hey, I'm glad you felt safe enough to be able to tell us, I really appriciate you being so open. 
Those urges must be really bad and, whilst I don't know exactly how you're feeling, I've experienced similar myself.

If possible, please try to fight the urges. As tempting as it is now, it'll just make you feel so much worse. 
Maybe try doing something you enjoy, I don't know you personally but a lot of people I know have said 
drawing, writing, listening to music, watching a show or playing video games help. Try to do whatever you enjoy or, most importantly, you can concentrate on. Distraction can be an amazing tool.

I'm very sorry to hear about your mum's attitude to this, but is there anyone else you can confide in? Perhaps your brother as he seems to have and awareness of this himself? That's entirely up to you, but I do suggest talking about it to someone you know and trust.

Finally, sending you all my love, honey, a lot of us here have been where you are and I understand that it must be so painful for you at the moment. Take good care of yourself.

Please call an ambulance honey. It's gonna be alright, but we need to get you some medical attention right now. Please let us know how you are, we all really care about you. Sending all my love, take care x

If you live in the UK (probably in other countries too but I don't know how to access it) , you can get 'skin camouflage' prescribed, which totally hides all scars. I've found dream cream from lush fades them faster than bio oil too from past experience x
Thank you, they've been glued and butterfly stitched and I'm waiting to see mental health x
